intro:
I found ways to make creative design work with real problems.
Every project starts somewhere different — a thought, a limitation, a strange reference, a business need. I turn these starting points into identities, digital experiences, objects and systems that have their own character
sketchIntro:
I found a way to turn random thoughts into things worth keeping on skin.
Some started as meaningless lines. Some came from symbols, objects, images or ideas I couldn’t get out of my head. These are the sketches that made it from my brain onto paper — and sometimes, onto someone’s skin.
